mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the respiratory organs of the fish."
The gills are the respiratory organs of the fish.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is known to be the best drainage system and it must be built before the construction of embankment."
Monk is known to be the best drainage system and it must be built before the construction of embankment.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major impediment to the realization of government goal towards increasing the contribution of the fisheries sector to the overall national economy."
High incidence of fish losses is a major impediment to the realization of government goal towards increasing the contribution of the fisheries sector to the overall national economy.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major source of protein and its harvesting, handling, processing and distribution provide livelihood for millions of people as well as providing foreign exchange earning to many countries."
Fish is a major source of protein and its harvesting, handling, processing and distribution provide livelihood for millions of people as well as providing foreign exchange earning to many countries.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the disposal of pond water as required by the procedures of fish farm management."
Drainage is the disposal of pond water as required by the procedures of fish farm management.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the growing of fish in ponds."
Fish culture is the growing of fish in ponds.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are composed of rows of long thin filament called primary lamella."
The hemibranch are composed of rows of long thin filament called primary lamella.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the primary method of fish culture."
Fish culture in ponds is the primary method of fish culture.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a rich source of enzymes that allow the living fish to digest its food .Once the fish is dead; these enzymes begin digesting the stomach itself."
The fish's gut is a rich source of enzymes that allow the living fish to digest its food .Once the fish is dead; these enzymes begin digesting the stomach itself.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the use of gears that produced unbiased samples."
The best collection method is the use of gears that produced unbiased samples.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the need for avoiding excess water and hence there must be arrangement for the excess water to escape through a bypass channel or a spillway."
Equally important is the need for avoiding excess water and hence there must be arrangement for the excess water to escape through a bypass channel or a spillway.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most common method of fish preservation in Nigeria."
Smoking or drying is the most common method of fish preservation in Nigeria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the processing of fish and other seafoods delivered by fisheries, which are the supplier of the fish products industry."
Fish processing is the processing of fish and other seafoods delivered by fisheries, which are the supplier of the fish products industry.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is composed of an upper stratum spongiosum and a deeper stratum compactum."
The dermis is composed of an upper stratum spongiosum and a deeper stratum compactum.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means releasing into the pond an adequate number of selected fish species which are of the right size."
Stocking a pond means releasing into the pond an adequate number of selected fish species which are of the right size.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refers to either annulus (A) or daily growth increment (D), depending on application."
Growth structure refers to either annulus (A) or daily growth increment (D), depending on application.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a water control structure associated mostly with brackish water pond."
Sluice gate is a water control structure associated mostly with brackish water pond.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is composed of two chambers, one ventricle and one atrium."
The heart is composed of two chambers, one ventricle and one atrium.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a place where large numbers of fish eggs are artificially fertilized and fry and are hatched in an enclosed environment."
A fish hatchery is a place where large numbers of fish eggs are artificially fertilized and fry and are hatched in an enclosed environment.
